INSERT INTO books (
  title,
  author,
  normalized_title,
  normalized_author,
  category,
  isbn13,
  publisher,
  published_at,
  aladin_status,
  aladin_item_id,
  aladin_link,
  aladin_cover_url,
  aladin_category_name,
  cover_image_url,
  retry_count,
  next_retry_at,
  error_reason,
  validated_at
)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.title.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.author.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.normalized_title.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.normalized_author.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.category.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  {{ $json.isbn13 ? "'" + $json.isbn13.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.publisher ? "'" + $json.publisher.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.published_at ? "'" + $json.published_at + "'::date" : 'NULL' }},
  'validated',
  {{ $json.aladin_item_id || 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.aladin_link ? "'" + $json.aladin_link.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.aladin_cover_url ? "'" + $json.aladin_cover_url.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.aladin_category_name ? "'" + $json.aladin_category_name.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  {{ $json.aladin_cover_url ? "'" + $json.aladin_cover_url.replace(/'/g, "''") + "'" : 'NULL' }},
  0,
  NOW(),
  NULL,
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (normalized_title, normalized_author) DO UPDATE SET
  category = EXCLUDED.category,
  isbn13 = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.isbn13, books.isbn13),
  publisher = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.publisher, books.publisher),
  published_at = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.published_at, books.published_at),
  aladin_status = 'validated',
  aladin_item_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.aladin_item_id, books.aladin_item_id),
  aladin_link = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.aladin_link, books.aladin_link),
  aladin_cover_url = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.aladin_cover_url, books.aladin_cover_url),
  aladin_category_name = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.aladin_category_name, books.aladin_category_name),
  cover_image_url = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.cover_image_url, books.cover_image_url),
  retry_count = 0,
  next_retry_at = NOW(),
  error_reason = NULL,
  validated_at = COALESCE(books.validated_at, NOW());
